name: BlueHeaven
source:
Mitsuru is a research assistant, content with his way of life. But when the leader, Kusuki, makes him put on women's clothing, he suddenly finds himself in charge of dealing with the men's sexual desires...

* Distressing situations in women's clothing include:
Forced to go in women's cloth, violation in woman's cloth, female cloth servant, female cloth 'lesbians', love-love in female cloth, man on man with female cloth on man and man on man on man!

* The entire story is played back with dramatic animation segments! An overflowing excitement! Please enjoy the union between the man in female cloth and the beautiful boys!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033543.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
滿作是個研究助理，對自己的生活方式感到滿足。但上司楠木讓他穿上女裝後，他突然發現自己必須應付男性的性慾……

*女裝下的煎熬情境包括：
被迫穿女裝、女裝下遭侵犯、女裝女僕、女裝「百合」、女裝戀愛、女裝男與男男，以及女裝男與多人男男！

*整個故事都透過戲劇化動畫片段播放！激動人心！請欣賞女裝男人與美少年之間的結合！
